data.name: printer PSU
requirements: Logix assembles the complete PSU; retain one BOM element. Candidate Power-One modules: HB5-3/OVP logic supply; HC24-2.4 is conditional on confirmation of the MPI mechanism actuator voltage and pulse current.

Module family documented in the Power-One advertisement in Electronics, 25 May 1978. Qualification remains unresolved: freeze rail-current and startup budgets, auxiliary rails, protection, mains variants, thermal derating and mechanical fit. These are sourcing proposals, not measured load budgets or released PSU designs.
